newsitem.title: TURKEY: Koc Holding aims to grow 13 pct in 97.
newsitem.headline: Koc Holding aims to grow 13 pct in 97.

text.p: Turkey's industrial conglomorate Koc Holding A.S. targets to grow by 13.3 in 1997, a senior company official said.
"We aim to grow by 13.3 percent in 1997, up from the average of the last four years," Rahmi Koc, president of the group, told the annual shareholders meeting.
The group's total turnover, excluding international trade revenues, rose 13.8 percent to 929 trillion lira in 1996.
The group increased its investments by 35.1 percent to 43 trillion lira.
It reported 6.67 trillion lira net profit in 1996 against 3.7 trillion lira in 1995. Koc will distribute 1.5 trillion lira of the income to the shareholders, Koc said.
